note: Provenance for every file in research/docs. Retrieved 2026-08-24.
warning_rolling_urls: The anevis factsheet URLs end in '_ultimo' and always serve the LATEST month-end. The same URL will return different data next month. The saved PDFs are snapshots of the 31.07.2026 edition; re-downloading does not reproduce them. Any ingestion of this source must snapshot and date-stamp, not re-fetch and assume stability.

factsheets.found_via: Document links on each fund page at bitcap.com/en/fonds/<fund-slug>

not_found.BIT Global Technology Opportunities: LU1640611676. No factsheet on the anevis endpoint under any share-class suffix tried (I, A, R-II, bare). Likely hosted elsewhere as a Luxembourg SICAV. Fund excluded from the report.

factsheets.role: AUM, allocations, top 10 and manager commentary only. Superseded as a position source by the statutory reports.

statutory_reports.role: PRIMARY position source: full Vermögensaufstellung, every holding with its weight.
statutory_reports.note: Each fund has its own financial year-end, so the freshest complete statement is sometimes the annual report and sometimes the semi-annual one. Both endpoints serve rolling latest editions.

not_available.BIT Crypto Opportunities: DE000A3CNGP6 — AIF, returns 404 on the hjb endpoint. Fund has no full portfolio in this dataset.

statutory_reports.validation: parse_portfolios.py reconciles each parsed portfolio against that report's own 'Summe Wertpapiervermögen' line and reports OK/!! per fund. All six currently reconcile to within EUR 1.

sec_13f.note: SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent header and rate-limits aggressively; the fetcher backs off on 429/503. Raw XML kept in docs/13f_raw/.

firm_profile.note: Marketing copy. Claims about the data platform (petabytes, token counts, share of trades touched by signals) are BIT's own and unverified.
